description: Runout of Liquefaction-Induced Tailings Dam Failure: Sensitivity Analysis is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Ellen Rathje, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). This dataset provide results from analyses of a liquefaction-induced tailings dam failure using a hybrid Finite Element and Material Point Method approach. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Liquefaction, Landslide, Flow, Earthquake. Published 2024-09-10. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
